{
"cycle": "rerun-3",
"assessment": "According to current 2026-07-06 implementation files, the previously requested coherence/design-order work is largely complete: docs now describe stage-compatible refs, compatible-ref stage presence, chart placement link checks, source-ledger bridging, and integrated reviewCoherence chart placement findings; tests cover slide/block/type/intent placement checks, optional reviewCoherence integration, nested design-order validation, entries[].stage ordering, and source-ledger bridging.    Current remaining gaps are not new model concepts; they are validator/link-scope hardening gaps. Office’s chart documentation confirms chart type remains data-purpose dependent, so mdpr-skill should keep enforcing semantic review order rather than renderer decisions. ([Microsoft 지원][1])",
"locally_actionable_todos": [
{
"title": "Make validateReviewArtifactDesignOrder enforce deck-trace prerequisites",
"why": "buildDeckDesignOrderTrace enforces dependsOn/status and stage-compatible refs, but validateReviewArtifactDesignOrder currently validates evidence presence, boundary leakage, and design-order sequence. A trace-like artifact with ordered entries can still omit required predecessor stages or mark later stages present without independently rechecking prerequisite semantics. This is not a duplicate of entries[].stage order scanning; it hardens prerequisite semantics for arbitrary review artifacts.  ",
"suggested_files": [
"packages/review-core/src/index.ts",
"tests/review-core-runtime.test.ts",
"docs/ppt-visual-validation.md",
"06_IR_CONTRACTS.md"
],
"acceptance": [
"When validateReviewArtifactDesignOrder receives a trace-like artifact with entries containing DeckDesignOrderStage values, it normalizes those entries and applies prerequisite checks equivalent to buildDeckDesignOrderTrace.",
"A trace-like artifact with chart_intent present but missing source_evidence or slide_role emits DESIGN_ORDER_PREREQUISITE_MISSING.",
"A trace-like artifact whose predecessor stage has only incompatible refs is treated as missing for validator prerequisite purposes.",
"Canonical buildDeckDesignOrderTrace output still validates without new findings.",
"Tests prove findings remain evidence-only and contain no raw colors, fixed coordinates, PPTX geometry, renderer object ids, raw workbook values, or final validation verdicts."
]
},
{
"title": "Add slide/narrative-scoped source-ledger bridge validation",
"why": "sourceEvidenceRefsFromLedger currently flattens ledger entries into deck-level source/evidence/claim/slide refs, and buildDeckDesignOrderTraceFromLedger checks only whether explicit refs overlap the global ledger ref set. That can let source_evidence for one narrative claim or slide be satisfied by refs from a different ledger entry. This is not a duplicate of the existing source-ledger bridge; it adds scoped coherence between narrative_spine, slide_role, and source_evidence.  ",
"suggested_files": [
"packages/review-core/src/index.ts",
"tests/review-core-runtime.test.ts",
"docs/ppt-visual-validation.md",
"06_IR_CONTRACTS.md"
],
"acceptance": [
"Preserve or derive per-ledger-entry scope using boundary-safe refs such as source:, evidence:, claim:, and slide:.",
"Emit SOURCE_EVIDENCE_LEDGER_SCOPE_MISMATCH when supplied sourceEvidenceRefs overlap the ledger globally but do not align with the trace’s narrativeSpineRefs or slideRoleRefs.",
"Do not copy raw claim text, raw source text, workbook values, coordinates, colors, or PPTX geometry into the trace.",
"Existing SOURCE_EVIDENCE_LEDGER_DISCONNECTED behavior remains unchanged for refs with no ledger overlap.",
"Tests cover a two-entry ledger where an Activation trace is incorrectly satisfied by Retention evidence and receives the scoped mismatch warning."
]
}
],
"external_or_manual_todos": [],
"duplicates_or_rejected": [
"Rejected as duplicate: DeckDesignOrderTrace and validateReviewArtifactDesignOrder creation.",
"Rejected as duplicate: structured chart visual guidance fields and narrativeFit checks.",
"Rejected as duplicate: EVIDENCE_CLAIM_ALIGNMENT_GAP, SEMANTIC_MOTIF_DRIFT, DESIGN_ORDER_SOURCE_EVIDENCE_BACKFILLED, nested intent/recipe validation, stage-ref namespace validation, compatible-ref stage presence, and entries[].stage order scanning.",
"Rejected as duplicate: CHART_PLACEMENT_SLIDE_MISSING, CHART_PLACEMENT_BLOCK_MISSING, CHART_PLACEMENT_BLOCK_TYPE_MISMATCH, CHART_PLACEMENT_INTENT_MISMATCH, CHART_NARRATIVE_FIT_GAP, and CHART_CLAIM_SUPPORT_MISSING.",
"Rejected as duplicate: source ledger to deck design-order bridge; only scoped bridge validation remains locally actionable.",
"Rejected as non-local or boundary-violating: final MDPR parsing/rendering/layout/theme resolution, PPTX geometry, renderer object decisions, pass/fail validation, manual visual inspection, credentials, external uploads, raw workbook values, raw colors, and fixed coordinates."
]
}

[1]: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/excel/available-chart-types-in-office?utm_source=chatgpt.com "Available chart types in Office"
